SYSTEM INSTRUCTION — SECTOR POST-SESSION REVIEW

Same spirit as general post-market autopsy, but the object is ONE sector ETF and its
environment — not SPX.

INPUTS (injected):
1. Morning sector prediction for this sector
2. Channel 1: actual sector ETF open/close/% change; SPY % change; relative return
3. Archived morning ETF context

STEPS (do not skip):
0. FACTS: sector ETF %, SPY %, relative %, path if known
1. What drove the sector today (taxonomy-aligned factors preferred)
2. Audit morning S0–S4 reads against reality (use morning numbers, not post-close
   rewrites of the morning)
3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open test
4. Outliers inside the sector

Evidence: CLAIM/URL/PUBLISHED/QUOTE/SUMMARY format for factual claims.

# Energy / XLE — 2026-09-28

Over the weekend the **load-bearing inputs inverted**: Trump **rejected** Iran’s seven-day Hormuz reopen, oil is **bid ~+2%**, and XLE is the **top premarket sector at +1.21%** while ES **−0.30%** / NQ **−0.49%** and XLK **−0.64%**. That is the **09-24 book** (risk-off rotation **into** energy), not the 09-21/09-25 laggard book. Count the oil-up + geo-premium-re-expansion cluster **once**. Do **not** treat Finviz $104 / BZ=F −5.2% as today’s smash or fade. Do **not** reuse Friday’s −1.44% rel as live S4. Asia composite **−0.88%** (Kospi **−2.7%**, Shanghai **−1.67%**, Nikkei **−0.73%**), Europe **+0.47%**. **VIX 16.0 (+1.13) with VIX/VIX3M 0.892 — contango**, so the 09-14 full-weight de-risking debit is **off**; VIX up 1.13 is still a live risk-off impulse. **USD strengthening** (DXY **+0.19%** 1d) is a mild producer headwind. **Real yields rising** (DFII10 **2.85, +0.09 1d / +0.24 1w / +0.53 1m**; DGS10 **5.18**) — secondary vs oil, genuine multiple headwind; 5-day 10Y-SPX corr **−0.877**. News Judge #1–#3 (10Y multi-decade highs, Oct hike odds ~64–73%, NFP/PCE pending) are the **SPX duration spine** and are **not pre-scored as an XLE factor**; they cap extension, they do not flip the oil sign. Cheaper-oil-as-SPX-bid is **off** this morning — oil is **up**. Per 09-21 **inverted** and 09-23/09-24: the red tape is the **funding source into** energy, not a reason to score S0 negative. 08-10 mute under sector_shock still binds: do not let ES/NQ color dominate S1. **S0 = +0.5** (rotation into the real-asset sleeve on a soft index; not +1 because USD up + real yields up + NQ red are a multiple lid).

BZ=F **−5.2%** and Finviz **$104.16** **rejected**. Still ~$94 / ~$106 — a **~2% rebound**, not 09-15’s physical-outage surge and not 08-25’s smash. Incremental move is **just through 1.5%**, so the day-3+/sub-1.5% S1 cap is **off**.
- **Geo premium re-expanding, not a confirmed new physical outage.** Knowable at open: Trump rejected Iran’s 7-day Hormuz roadmap (NYT/BBC/Al Jazeera 09-26/27); Al Jazeera 09-27 reports explosions near Qeshm (Iranian media; **authorities did not confirm**); WSJ weekend color that Trump may resume strikes after midterms; Oilprice 00:37 CDT “oil jumps on rekindled war fears,” Brent **$107.24** / WTI **$94.10**. **Offset, same session:** Kpler/Reuters ME exports rebound to **12.8 mbpd** (Saudi STS in the Gulf of Oman; Wright “running average” ~**13 mbpd**). Oilprice explicitly: the flow rebound **failed to offset** war fears this morning. News Judge #4: **mixed**, not a documented fresh kinetic wave. **Do not** score a second Geopolitical HIT on top of the oil print. **Do not** fire 09-15’s notable license.
- **Inventory: leftover build, next print unprinted.** EIA week ended 9/18 (released **9/23**): crude **+3.0 Mb** to **426.4 Mb** (~2% above 5-year avg); Cushing **+2.3 Mb**; gasoline **−1.7 Mb**, distillates **−0.4 Mb**. Live PM **+1.21%** agrees with S1; it is not a divergence.

**6. Earnings / policy.** No XLE-captain earnings catalyst this morning. OPEC Oct 4 and EIA Sep 30 are **forward two-sided**. NFP/PCE **not pre-scored**.

Taxonomy: **geopolitical supply-risk premium (HIT, then faded)** + **sector rotation into energy on a risk-off tape (HIT, relative only)** + **real yields / 10Y as a multiple lid (HIT)**. Not a physical-outage day, not an inventory day, not OPEC.

The open was the morning book: Trump’s weekend rejection of Iran’s 7-day Hormuz reopen re-expanded the war premium; oil jumped; XLE was the premarket leader while ES/NQ were soft. Midday tape still described energy as a **defensive gainer** while indexes slid on yields and faded Hormuz-reopen hopes.

The close was digestion, not a new shock. No confirmed fresh kinetic wave, Kpler/Reuters flow rebound to **12.8 mbpd** stayed in the tape, and WTI was also leaned on by diesel-export-ban talk. Crude spiked to **$96.54** and dumped to **$91.25**. XLE never extended the gap (high only **2 cents** above the open) and gave back ~**1.1%** from the open. Captains split: XOM/CVX held green, COP faded.

## 3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open

Morning double-count hygiene was good: Trump-reject + Qeshm + oil-up = **one** S1 cluster. They did not restack PM +1.21% into S0, S2, and S4. They did not reuse Friday’s −1.44% rel. They did not treat Finviz $104 / BZ=F −5.2% as live.

The interaction they named but underweighted: **oil-up and 10Y-up are the same inflation cluster.** The geo bid that gapped XLE is also what sent 10Y to **5.26%** and capped the equity multiple. That is why energy can be the **leader** and still close **flat**. Morning said duration “caps extension, does not flip the oil sign” — correct, and that is exactly the close.

**Knowable at open:** weekend reject, live oil ~+2%, PM XLE +1.21%, soft ES/NQ, leftover EIA, Oct 4 OPEC, unprinted NFP/PCE, flow rebound as a **size** offset. **Not knowable at open:** whether the premium would hold through the cash session, the $96.54→$91.25 oil reversal, or that XLE’s high would be the open.

They explicitly declined the gap-fade lesson because 1m rel was not ≥+8% and the weekend increment was “fresh vs Friday,” not day-3 of the same shock. Fair on **shock identity**. Still a **≥1% gap with no extension** — the fade printed anyway.
